action: Every completed flow is scored; score, model version, feature-set version and threshold are written to the alert log
Alerts matching an approved scanner entry on source, port, schedule and expiry are marked suppressed, never deleted
Score >= 0.99 high, 0.90-0.99 medium, threshold-0.90 low; low-tier alerts are grouped by source rather than raised one by one
Alerts are grouped per source host over 5 min, 1 h and 24 h windows; a source crossing 50 distinct ports with over 80% unanswered is escalated even if each flow scored low
An analyst confirms or rejects. No automatic blocking at any tier: a false alarm must not be able to cut off a real user

Confirmed external scan: rate-limit the source at the perimeter and open an incident. Confirmed internal scan: contact the owner and, if it is authorised testing (Scarfone et al., 2008), add a time-boxed allowlist entry
Every analyst verdict is stored with the flow and the score, forming the labelled pool the next model is trained and tested on
